title: No Bones About It

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Back with good news I hope?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Back with good news I hope?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Here yah go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here yah go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do you use the bones again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do you use the bones again?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How do you use the bones again?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How do you use the bones again?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Any luck fixing the relays?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any luck fixing the relays?

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Without the materials you were fetching? Did Harms come through or was she fresh out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Without the materials you were fetching? Did Harms come through or was she fresh out?

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: It has something to do with the conductivity of calcium or something. I don't know. I failed that particular science session. Was more focused on building things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It has something to do with the conductivity of calcium or something. I don't know. I failed that particular science session. Was more focused on building things.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You liked doing this from a young age?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You liked doing this from a young age?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You liked doing this from a young age?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You liked doing this from a young age?

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Oh sure. Little things made sense growing up but putting parts together in the correct order was always easy. Just follow directions. And right now my directions are asking for some bones.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh sure. Little things made sense growing up but putting parts together in the correct order was always easy. Just follow directions. And right now my directions are asking for some bones.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Yup, that'll do it. Freakin' Harmony man. She always comes through. Whatever you need she can get.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yup, that'll do it. Freakin' Harmony man. She always comes through. Whatever you need she can get.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How does she get all those things?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How does she get all those things?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How does she get all those things?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How does she get all those things?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How can they make things out of human bone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How can they make things out of human bone?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How can they make things out of human bone?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How can they make things out of human bone?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, good luck with all this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, good luck with all this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, good luck with all this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, good luck with all this.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Owe you one. With this stuff I'll be able to get outta here by oh, I don't know, dawn at this point. HA! I laugh but it's sad. Oh well, that's life. Cheers!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Owe you one. With this stuff I'll be able to get outta here by oh, I don't know, dawn at this point. HA! I laugh but it's sad. Oh well, that's life. Cheers!

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Stop... Did you just say human bone?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Stop... Did you just say human bone?!

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Beats me. I never ask, just say thank you and hand her the Lims. How much she charge you for these by the way?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Beats me. I never ask, just say thank you and hand her the Lims. How much she charge you for these by the way?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...two hundred dollars.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...two hundred dollars.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nothing. Said she can't because of the cannibal clause.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing. Said she can't because of the cannibal clause.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Nothing. Said she can't because of the cannibal clause.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Nothing. Said she can't because of the cannibal clause.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Cannibal Clause?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cannibal Clause?!

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Neon Gods! I love the little merchant but her prices have definitely gone up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Neon Gods! I love the little merchant but her prices have definitely gone up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How often are you buying human bones from her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How often are you buying human bones from her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How often are you buying human bones from her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How often are you buying human bones from her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, she said human bones fall under the Cannibal Clause in the Intercity Free Trade and Commerce Agreement.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, she said human bones fall under the Cannibal Clause in the Intercity Free Trade and Commerce Agreement.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, she said human bones fall under the Cannibal Clause in the Intercity Free Trade and Commerce Agreement.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, she said human bones fall under the Cannibal Clause in the Intercity Free Trade and Commerce Agreement.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Okay, okay, okay, okay. Let's take a breath and look at the parts of this conversation. Are these human bones, yes or no?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay, okay, okay, okay. Let's take a breath and look at the parts of this conversation. Are these human bones, yes or no?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Good, that's what we need. Hahahaha! You should see your face right now. Wait, hold on, I'll take a picture. Hahaha.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good, that's what we need. Hahahaha! You should see your face right now. Wait, hold on, I'll take a picture. Hahaha.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hahaha. Good one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hahaha. Good one.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would you do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would you do that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm outta here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm outta here.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Gotta have a sense of humor!!!!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gotta have a sense of humor!!!!
